system.description: PARTY, ADVENTURERS, IDEALISTIC PARTY TENSION METER Each party member suffers 1 stress and must adjust his stance meter 1 step more Reckless Each party member suffers 2 stress and must adjust his stance meters 1 step more [Dre]: Then the tension resets to zero IMMORTALISED IN STORIES When a member of the Glory Hounds spends a fortune point to add a fortune die to a [Dre], he recovers either 1 stress or 1 fatigue if the action is successful
